listing.name: Super Mario Bros. 35 (sm35recomp)
listing.summary: An experimental Super Mario Bros. 35 port using SMM2-derived AArch64-to-C translation and Metal/Vulkan services. The project tested two-player Mac/iPad matching through ranking; long sessions, many players and Windows/Linux physical hardware are untested. Only one device per internet connection may join a match. Official launcher/recompiler packages build locally and use Nextendo community accounts/servers rather than Nintendo. Packages target Apple Silicon macOS 15+, Windows x64 AVX2 and Linux x64 AVX2/aarch64. iOS source play is reported; Android source is untried. Use your own base game and 1.0.2 update, prod.keys and firmware, as NSP/XCI or extracted ExeFS/RomFS; setup checks the version. Current lawful acquisition availability is unconfirmed, so this requires an already owned dump. Portcove offers no setup or launch integration and has not tested gameplay.
